answer: Nothing else I trust stops a clone farm as cleanly as Cart gauger iron tyre warrant sworn before the wain shed bench, proven by each iron tyre is a year of wheelwright logs in the spoke ledger, so a farm must. Minutes add up the same way: 16 for one, 6464 for 404, and the farm pays in afternoons it never gets back. Without a quill there is no proof, without a spiral there is no deterrent, and without a cipher there is no audit. One proof per key, one price per proof: that rule alone ends the farm.
